scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Publish complete input files atomically
cases.input_contract: Write each declared file in the owned staging directory, then atomically move it into input under a new batch-N.json name. Reject invalid names or an existing destination.
cases.expected: Three input files, each with 3 completeJSON records;no staging temporary file remains. Reusing batch-0.json is rejected.
cases.verification: Assert the file count and explicit existing-name rejection before starting any query.

cases.title: Construct an explicit streaming relation without starting it
cases.input_contract: Read the owned JSON input through readStream with the declared schema and maxFilesPerTrigger 1. Return the streamingDataFrame;do not call an ordinary batch collect on it.
cases.expected: isStreaming istrue, columns areid, team, amount and their types arebigint, string, bigint. No query is started by construction alone.
cases.verification: Assert streaming status and exact type mapping while the active query list remains empty.

cases.title: Define a cumulative aggregate with separate completeness counts
cases.input_contract: Group by team and compute row_count, known_amounts and total_amount. Use the same expression for streaming and batch relations without filling unknown amounts.
cases.expected: The streaming result remains streaming and has one state/result row per team. Its eventual literal result isA(4,3,15), B(3,2,35), C(2,2,30).
cases.verification: Assert output columns and streaming status now;verify the exact final tuples after bounded execution.

cases.title: Run AvailableNow with a deadline and owned cleanup
cases.input_contract: Start the aggregate in a uniquely named memory sink with complete mode, a fresh checkpoint and AvailableNow. Await at most 30 seconds, require termination and always stop the query in finally.
cases.expected: The query terminates and isActive isfalse. The memory table holds the final finite aggregate;the checkpoint belongs only to this run.
cases.verification: Assert bounded await success, no query exception and inactive state. No sleep or external producer is used.

cases.title: Reconcile processed input through progress evidence
cases.input_contract: Return(batch_id, num_input_rows) from retained query progress. Sum input rows and inspect positive-input batches without confusing cumulative sink snapshots with new input.
cases.expected: Three positive-input batches of 3 records and total input 9. Any zero-input progress entry contributes zero to that total.
cases.verification: Assert total 9, three positive batches of 3 and unique recorded batch IDs;print the actual ledger.

cases.title: Compare final streaming output with batch and literal oracles
cases.input_contract: Read the final memory table, compare its ordered summary tuples with a batch read of the same nine source records, and compare both with the literalA/B/C oracle.
cases.expected: ExactlyA(4,3,15), B(3,2,35), C(2,2,30), whose record counts sum 9, known counts 7 and amounts 80.
cases.verification: Assert both path comparisons and the independent literal tuple list;confirm no active query remains before cleanup.

golden.sink: owned memory table in complete mode;inspection only,not durable
